units.source_text: 且说一品公主患病，僧都的禳解果如他的徒弟们所称颂的那样灵验，不久就痊愈了。

en.t: Now the First Rank Princess had fallen ill, and the bishop's rites of exorcism proved as effective as his disciples had praised them to be; before long she recovered.

units.source_text: 于是世人越发赞佩僧都法力之尊严。

en.t: People therefore admired and revered the solemn power of the bishop's religious practice all the more.

units.source_text: 犹恐病后复发，特将祈祷日子延长。

en.t: Still fearing that the illness might return after her recovery, they deliberately extended the days of prayer.

units.source_text: 因此僧都并不立刻回山，依旧留住宫中。

en.t: For that reason the bishop did not immediately return to his mountain temple, but remained in the palace as before.

units.source_text: 岑寂的雨夜，明石皇后宣召僧都到公主寝处近旁做通夜祈祷。

en.t: On a silent rainy night, Empress Akashi summoned the bishop to the area near the princess's sleeping chamber to pray through the night.

units.source_text: 侍女们值宿看护了多天，都很疲劳，

en.t: The ladies in waiting had spent many days keeping night watch and nursing her, and they were all very tired,

units.source_text: 大都回房休息去了，故御前侍女甚少，随侍身旁的人也不多。

en.t: so most had gone back to their rooms to rest, leaving very few attendants before her and not many people at her side.

units.source_text: 明石皇后便也进入一品公主帐内，对僧都说：

en.t: Empress Akashi also went inside the First Rank Princess's curtains and said to the bishop:

units.source_text: “皇上以前就信任你，而此次的效验尤为显著。

en.t: His Majesty trusted you even before, but the effect this time has been especially clear.

units.source_text: 我越发想把后世之事仰仗你了。”

en.t: I feel all the more that I should entrust the affairs of the next life to you.

units.source_text: 僧都启禀：

en.t: The bishop respectfully replied:

units.source_text: “贫僧世寿已不久长，曾蒙佛菩萨屡次预示。

en.t: This poor monk's span of life in the world is no longer long, as the Buddhas and bodhisattvas have shown me many times.

units.source_text: 就中今年明年，尤难度过。

en.t: Among all years, this year and next year will be especially hard to pass through.

units.source_text: 因此近来闭居深山，专心修持。

en.t: For that reason I have lately shut myself away deep in the mountains and devoted myself to religious practice.

units.source_text: 此次因蒙宣召，故特破例下山。”

en.t: This time, because I received your summons, I made a special exception and came down from the mountain.

units.source_text: 以下又谈及此次作祟的鬼怪如何顽强、曾招出种种姓名……等可怕的事。

en.t: He then spoke of frightening matters, such as how stubborn the spirit causing this affliction had been and how various names had been drawn out of it.

units.source_text: 便中又说：

en.t: In the course of this, he added:

units.source_text: “贫僧最近曾经遇到一件非常奇怪、世间稀有的事情呢。

en.t: Recently this poor monk encountered something extremely strange, a thing rare in this world.

units.source_text: 今年三月间，老母赴初濑观音寺还愿，归途中患病，

en.t: Around the third month of this year, my aged mother went to Hase Kannon Temple to fulfill a vow, and on the way home she fell ill,

units.source_text: 借宿在一个名叫宇治院的宅中，以便休养。

en.t: so she took lodging in a residence called Uji-in in order to rest and recover.

units.source_text: 这是一座经年没有人住的广大宅院，

en.t: It was a vast estate that had been uninhabited for many years,

units.source_text: 贫僧等深恐有不良之物栖息其中，为重病人作祟，

en.t: and we deeply feared that some evil thing might be dwelling there and might harm a gravely ill person,

units.source_text: 岂知果然……”

en.t: but who would have thought that it was truly so...

units.source_text: 便把找到一个女子的情形如实说出。

en.t: He then told truthfully how they had found a woman there.

units.source_text: 明石皇后说：

en.t: Empress Akashi said:

units.source_text: “这确是一件稀奇的事！”

en.t: That truly is a strange matter!

units.source_text: 她觉得害怕，便把近旁睡着了的侍女都叫醒。

en.t: She became frightened and woke all the ladies in waiting who were sleeping nearby.

units.source_text: 薰大将所怜爱的侍女小宰相君不曾睡觉，也听到僧都这话。

en.t: Kozaisho no Kimi, the lady in waiting cherished by General Kaoru, had not been asleep and also heard the bishop's words.

units.source_text: 其他被叫醒来的人则全都不曾听到。

en.t: The others who were awakened had not heard any of it.

units.source_text: 僧都觉察到明石皇后害怕，自悔不该说这件事，

en.t: The bishop noticed Empress Akashi's fear and regretted having spoken of the matter,

units.source_text: 便不再详叙当时情况，只谈后来的事：

en.t: so he stopped describing the circumstances in detail and spoke only of what happened afterward:

units.source_text: “此次贫僧下山之时，顺路访问住在小野草庵中的尼僧。

en.t: When this poor monk came down from the mountain this time, I stopped on the way to visit the nun living in a thatched hut at Ono.

units.source_text: 进了庵室，这女子啼啼哭哭地向贫僧诉说出家的决心，

en.t: When I entered the hut, this woman tearfully told me of her resolve to take religious vows,

units.source_text: 诚恳地请求替她授戒，贫僧就给她剃度了。

en.t: and because she earnestly begged me to administer the precepts, I tonsured her.

units.source_text: 那尼僧是贫僧的妹妹，已故卫门督之妻，

en.t: That nun is my younger sister, the wife of the late Captain of the Right Gate Guards,

units.source_text: 她有一个女儿，已经死了，

en.t: and she had a daughter, who has already died.

units.source_text: 获得了这女子非常欢喜，想拿她来代替她的女儿，

en.t: She was overjoyed to have found this woman and wanted to treat her as a replacement for her daughter,

units.source_text: 全心全意地抚养她。

en.t: so she cared for and raised her with all her heart.

units.source_text: 贫僧给她剃度了，她就埋怨贫僧。

en.t: When I tonsured her, the nun resented me for it.

units.source_text: 这原是难怪她的，因为这女子相貌生得非常美丽，

en.t: One can hardly blame her, for this woman was born with extraordinary beauty,

units.source_text: 为了修行而瘦损芳容，实甚可惜。

en.t: and it was truly a pity for her lovely appearance to be worn thin by religious practice.

units.source_text: 但不知此女究系何等样人。”

en.t: But I do not know what sort of person this woman really is.

units.source_text: 这僧都能言善辩，滔滔不绝地讲。

en.t: This bishop was eloquent and persuasive, and he spoke on without pause.

units.source_text: 小宰相君问道：

en.t: Kozaisho no Kimi asked:

units.source_text: “这种荒凉的地方，怎么会弄来了这样一个美人呢？

en.t: How could such a beauty have come to such a desolate place?

units.source_text: 她究竟是谁？

en.t: Who is she really?

units.source_text: 现在想已知道了吧。”

en.t: By now, I suppose you must know.

units.source_text: 僧都答道：

en.t: The bishop answered:

units.source_text: “不知道。

en.t: I do not know.

units.source_text: 但现在或许她已经说出了。

en.t: But perhaps by now she has revealed it.

units.source_text: 倘真是个身份高贵的人，总不能隐瞒到底。

en.t: If she truly is a person of high rank, she cannot keep it hidden forever.

units.source_text: 但田舍人家的女儿，也有生得这样美丽的。

en.t: Still, even daughters of country households can be born with such beauty.

units.source_text: 龙中不是会生出佛来的么？

en.t: After all, can a Buddha not be born among dragons?

units.source_text: 这女子倘是身份低微的人，定然是前世罪孽轻微，故能得此美貌。”

en.t: If this woman is of low birth, then surely the sins of her previous life were slight, and so she gained this beauty.

units.source_text: 明石皇后便想起了以前宇治那边失踪了的浮舟。

en.t: Empress Akashi then remembered Ukifune, who had once disappeared in the Uji area.

units.source_text: 小宰相君也曾从匂亲王夫人那里听说过此人死得非常奇怪，

en.t: Kozaisho no Kimi had also heard from Prince Niou's wife that this person's death had been extremely strange,

units.source_text: 料想僧都所说的或许正是此人，但也不能确定。

en.t: and she thought the person the bishop spoke of might be that very woman, though she could not be certain.

units.source_text: 僧都又说：

en.t: The bishop continued:

units.source_text: “这女子曾经说过：

en.t: This woman once said:

units.source_text: 不要让别人知道她还活在世间。

en.t: Do not let anyone know that she is still alive in this world.

units.source_text: 看来她似乎有凶恶的敌人，所以要躲藏吧。

en.t: It seems she has some dangerous enemy, and that is why she wants to hide.

units.source_text: 因为事情稀奇，所以乘便禀告。”

en.t: Because the matter is so unusual, I have taken this chance to report it.

units.source_text: 明石皇后对小宰相君说：

en.t: Empress Akashi said to Kozaisho no Kimi:

units.source_text: “正是这个人了。

en.t: It must be that very person.

units.source_text: 你可告诉薰大将。”

en.t: You may tell General Kaoru.

units.source_text: 但她不曾确知这是否薰大将和浮舟双方都要隐瞒的事，

en.t: But she did not know for certain whether this was something both General Kaoru and Ukifune wished to keep hidden,

units.source_text: 觉得未便告诉这个斯文一脉的薰大将，

en.t: and she felt it would be awkward to tell the refined and sensitive General Kaoru,

units.source_text: 故终于不曾叫小宰相君去说。

en.t: so in the end she did not send Kozaisho no Kimi to tell him.
